_comment: Field checks that eaglegate_text.py and textCheck.js must agree on (pytest and pnpm test run both). Expected reasons come from the Python implementation.

cases.name: safe text accepts a plain sentence
ANSI escape is refused
cases.expect: byte 0x1B (ESC) at offset 2 is not allowed by profile printable

cases.name: CR LF log forging is refused
cases.expect: byte 0x0D (CR) at offset 2 is not allowed by profile printable

cases.name: command substitution is refused by safe_text
cases.expect: byte 0x24 '$' at offset 4 is not allowed by profile safe_text

cases.name: backtick is refused by safe_text
cases.expect: byte 0x60 (backtick) at offset 1 is not allowed by profile safe_text

cases.name: script tag is refused by safe_text
cases.expect: byte 0x3C '<' at offset 0 is not allowed by profile safe_text

cases.name: log4shell lookup is refused by safe_text
cases.expect: byte 0x24 '$' at offset 1 is not allowed by profile safe_text

cases.name: printf format is refused by safe_text
cases.expect: byte 0x25 '%' at offset 0 is not allowed by profile safe_text

cases.name: formula start is refused
cases.expect: starts with 0x3D '=', which spreadsheets treat as a formula

cases.name: formula start allowed when switched off
plus and at formula starts
cases.expect: starts with 0x40 '@', which spreadsheets treat as a formula

cases.name: identifier refuses a space
cases.expect: byte 0x20 (space) at offset 4 is not allowed by profile identifier

cases.name: identifier refuses a leading dash (argument injection)
cases.expect: byte 0x2D '-' is not allowed as the first character by profile identifier

cases.name: path accepts an absolute file name
path refuses traversal
cases.expect: contains denied substring #1 ".."

cases.name: denied substrings are case-insensitive
cases.expect: contains denied substring #1 "drop table"

cases.name: hex profile refuses g
cases.expect: byte 0x47 'G' at offset 7 is not allowed by profile hex

cases.name: non-ASCII byte refused in ascii
cases.expect: byte 0xE2 (non-ASCII) at offset 1 is not allowed by profile printable

cases.name: data hidden after the NUL
cases.expect: data after the NUL terminator at offset 4

cases.name: no padding: a NUL is just a bad byte
cases.expect: byte 0x00 (NUL) at offset 2 is not allowed by profile identifier

cases.name: min_length after padding
cases.expect: text is 0 bytes, shorter than min_length 1

cases.name: max_length
cases.expect: text is 4 bytes, longer than max_length 3

cases.name: also_deny removes characters
cases.expect: byte 0x25 '%' at offset 3 is not allowed by profile printable

cases.name: custom profile
cases.expect: byte 0x5A 'Z' at offset 5 is not allowed by profile custom

cases.name: utf8 refuses a right-to-left override (Trojan Source)
cases.expect: character U+202E at offset 3 is not allowed: control, format or unassigned character

cases.name: utf8 refuses zero-width space
cases.expect: character U+200B at offset 2 is not allowed: control, format or unassigned character

cases.name: utf8 refuses C1 control CSI
cases.expect: character U+009B at offset 1 is not allowed: control, format or unassigned character

cases.name: utf8 refuses line separator
cases.expect: character U+2028 at offset 1 is not allowed: line or paragraph separator

cases.name: utf8 refuses full-width semicolon (NFKC)
cases.expect: character U+FF1B at offset 1 is not allowed: it normalizes (NFKC) to 0x3B ';', which profile safe_text does not allow

cases.name: utf8 refuses invalid bytes
cases.expect: invalid UTF-8 at offset 1

cases.name: utf8 refuses an overlong encoding
cases.expect: invalid UTF-8 at offset 1

cases.name: utf8 refuses a truncated sequence
cases.expect: invalid UTF-8 at offset 1

cases.name: utf8 refuses an encoded surrogate
cases.expect: invalid UTF-8 at offset 0

cases.name: utf8 identifier allows no non-ASCII by default
cases.expect: character U+00E9 at offset 5 is not allowed: profile identifier allows no other characters

cases.name: utf8 ASCII-only text takes the fast path
cases.expect: byte 0x3B ';' at offset 4 is not allowed by profile identifier

cases.name: raw: every byte allowed by default
raw: 7-bit only
cases.expect: byte 0xFF (non-ASCII) at offset 2 is not allowed

cases.name: raw: deny ESC
cases.expect: byte 0x1B (ESC) at offset 2 is not allowed

cases.name: raw: denied byte sequence
cases.expect: contains denied byte sequence #1 (1b5b)

cases.name: raw: decimal byte values
cases.expect: byte 0x3A ':' at offset 3 is not allowed
